question: Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter ⇒ Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (4).
 
• Second and third letter ⇒ Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (2).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : NRT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9326f7c0e342c527e3eeab1290b5483986286ba7130a7263ce73c8ecf797298.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : LPR

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9396791d6e4eb702460aff7382e5c9112a56ee2bfbbf5b1a2764ea80474e10e6.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : EIK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae8c5ad5d165621a64cb2a31a357e43291e3b97056ae430b74e6254be37889bd.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : BFI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b509af2f5d6340624aed77af20f96b96ac261dfa9dfc69498a382d00c50fbb3.png] 

Here, Out of all options 'BFI' is the odd one out.

​Hence, "**BFI**" is the correct answer.
